contract.task_clause:
Vygotsky’s sociocultural development theory attempts to describe the interaction between the mental function children are born with and how they develop those into what they possess as adults. One of the important components of this is the zone of proximal development. Which of the following statements accurately describes an individual in the zone of proximal development?
Option A: A baseball player hits baseballs from a tee in order to build muscle memory.
Option B: A concert flute player falls short of finishing a piece that has a very complex ending without mistakes
Option C: A high school English student submits a paper for review by his professor.
Option D: A high diver takes instruction from her coach to improve her form on a specific move.
